sentences.text:

Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1. List has been revised.
2. Compliance affidavit filed today is taken on record.

3. Heard Sri Shad Khan, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri V.K.S. Parmar, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material placed on record.
4.
Learned A.G.A. has informed that the notice to the informant has been served on 03.12.2024.
5. Applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.355 of 2024, under Sections 328, 376(3), 506 I.P.C. and 3/4(2) POCSO Act, Police Station Anupshahr, District Bulandshahr, during the pendency of trial.
6. Learned counsel for the applicant has argued that the applicant is absolutely innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.

The victim is major aged between 17-18 years as per ossification test report and a leverage of two years may be granted to the applicant on the upper side.
7. Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicant to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against him.
The circumstances which, as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicant have also been touched upon at length.
There is no criminal history of the applicant.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 21.09.2024 and he is ready to cooperate with trial.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.

12. Let the applicant-Salim, who is involved in aforementioned case crime be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
(i) The applicant shall not tamper with evidence.

(ii) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the Trial Court on dates fixed for (1) opening of the case, (2) framing of charge and (3) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C./351 B.N.S.S.

If in the opinion of the Trial Court absence of the applicant is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the Trial Court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of bail and proceed against him in accordance with law.
13. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
